RSSXSIM.caveat: BTCSIM history starts 2010-07; structural survivorship and non-stationarity bias — assumption-heavy proxy, not evidence.

TLTPROXY.rationale: duration blend ~17y matches TLT; cache has no TLTSIM

TMFSIM_D.note: financing-explicit; synths.tmf_synth_returns omits the 2x cash borrow and is not used (decision documented in METHODS.md)

extended.RSST_EXT_HAIRCUT: same, with pre-1988 MF excess over CASHX scaled x0.5 (UMD splice overstates MF Sharpe ~3x)
caveats: KMLM pre-1988 = Ken French UMD + RF academic momentum proxy

rssy_monthly.formula: RSSYSIM = SPYSIM_M + CARRY_SCALED - 0.0200/12; CARRY_SCALED = AQR 'All Macro Carry' x 2.229 (10% ann-vol target, full-sample in-sample scalar — disclosed)
rssy_monthly.frequency: MONTHLY-NATIVE — never mix into daily tables
rssy_monthly.attribution: AQR Capital Management, 'Century of Factor Premia' dataset, AQR Data Library (research use with attribution)
